description: Turn a place name into coordinates for build_trip_link — towns, cities, airports (IATA or name), parks, trailheads. Returns up to six candidates with lat/lng and where each one is, so you can pick the right Reno. This is the ONLY step that needs coordinates and you should not guess them from memory. It asks thistripbtw.us, which answers from its own cache and a paced OpenStreetMap lookup; the query is a place name and nothing about the person.

query.description: The place as a person would say it: "Moab, UT", "SFO", "Arches National Park".

name: find_place

results.description: Up to six candidates, best first.

where.description: The fuller name, for telling two same-named places apart.
